name: auto-model
description: Picks the model for each turn from how hard your prompt looks: haiku, sonnet, opus or fable, with high thinking effort on every tier by default.

judge.title: How difficulty is judged
judge.description: heuristic: local rules, instant and free. model: a quick call to the judge model reads the prompt first (adds about a second and a small cost), falling back to the rules if it fails.

judgeModel.title: Judge model
judgeModel.description: Model alias or full id that grades prompts when the judge is model. A fast model is enough.

modelEasy.title: Easy prompts: model
modelEasy.description: Model alias (haiku, sonnet, opus, fable) or a full model id, for easy prompts.

modelMedium.title: Medium prompts: model
modelMedium.description: Model alias (haiku, sonnet, opus, fable) or a full model id, for medium prompts.

modelHard.title: Hard prompts: model
modelHard.description: Model alias (haiku, sonnet, opus, fable) or a full model id, for hard prompts.

modelExpert.title: Expert prompts: model
modelExpert.description: Model alias (haiku, sonnet, opus, fable) or a full model id, for the very hardest prompts.

effortExpert.title: Expert prompts: thinking effort
effortExpert.description: Thinking effort for the very hardest prompts.
